# Llama 2 13B Chat

Meta · released 2023-07 · 13.02B params · llama2

**score 32.9** ±0.9 · #474 of 551 · from 23 benchmark results across 13 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-models/blob/0e0b8c519242d5833d8c11bffc1232b77ad7f301/models/llama2/MODEL_CARD.md): Context length from the maker's official repository.</sub>

<pre>
download        size  score
4-bit q4_0   ~8.31GB   32.9
8-bit q8_0  ~16.12GB   32.9
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_0
ollama run llama2:13b-chat
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run llama2:13b-chat-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
